KIRAN C. PATEL MESSAGE FROM THE PRO-CHANCELLOR UNIVERSITY OFFICERS STATUTORY RECOGNITION NEWS LETTER AND COMMUNIQUE FOUNDED IN 2000 Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT) The Krishna Edu Campus, established by Shree Krishna Educational and Charitable Trust (SKECT), today, stands testimony as the significant hub for educational excellence, consistently in the pursuit of newer horizon. Since its inception during the year 2004, the institutions run by it has been providing equitable professional education offering programs, the most sought-after by meritorious students in Engineering, Pharmacy, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Ayurveda and Pure Science, both at UG & PG level in an environment conducive for academic and professional growth. Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel, Founder President & Managing Trustee of SKECT, has been an ardent dynamic leader known for his passion for Excellence and relentless actions. Over the decades, he has transformed himself into a proactive administrator with the capacity to execute mega-projects associated with education, healthcare, and nursing sectors. The institution offered numerous Freeships and Scholarships amounting to ₹ 16.20 Crores allocated to support meritorious underprivileged students since its inception. SKECT has fostered active international collaborations with Carleton Global Academy-Carleton University, Canada, University of North Alabama (UNA), USA, Catholic University of Murcia (UCAM), Spain and North Southern Eastern University (NSU), Florida for academic exchange programs. FORMERLY BITS EDU CAMPUS KPGU Vadodara Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) Vadodara, (formerly BITS Edu Campus) offers quality education in Engineering and Technology, Health-Care, Science, Commerce and Management, Nursing. Established as a Private University in 2021 under the provisions of the Gujarat Private Universities Act, 2009 and Gujarat Private Universities (Amendment) Act, 2021 (Gujarat Act 15 of 2021). KPGU aims to become a “University of Global Eminence,” aligned with its vision to serve higher education, healthcare, and humanity with relentless pursuit of progress. By adhering to the KPGU Vision-2040, KPGU has positioned itself as a “Gateway to Global Excellence,” to explore opportunities that will elevate performance to new levels. KPGU has increased infrastructure to about 18 lakhs Sq.ft. and focused on Skill, Interdisciplinary, Industry driven curriculum with global appeal, collaborative research, social inclusiveness w.r.t. National Development Goals through its qualified faculty. Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate & Doctoral Programs 6 University Faculties & 11 Constituent Institutions 6 Centers of Excellence State-of-the-art Campus at Varnama, Vadodara UGC, AICTE, PCI, AYUSH, GNC , INC & GSCPT Approved KPGU at a Glance... • Implemented Comprehensive Research Policy to motivate faculty and students to conduct research, that led to complete 101 Research Projects amounting to ₹ 32 Lakhs from AICTE & GUJCOST and 4.50 Crores from SSIP and SOIC. • Grant sanctioned from Govt. Agencies: 3 Cr from Startup India- Govt. of India and 2 Cr from GKS under SSIP, Govt. of Gujarat in 2022. • Created academic eco-system for learning and research, including instruments (GC, FTIR, HPLC), facilities (FAB LAB, High Voltage Lab, PLC, CAD/CAM, MATLAP, PSIM, PRO-E), Botanical Garden and Animal House. • Published scientific papers (168) in SCI Journals, granted 6 industrial design and awarded 4 patents out of 45 under examination and 20 more patents under prosecution. • Established Institute Innovation Council (IIC) under MOEs Innovation Cell (Govt. of India) and recipient of 3.5 star ranking and listed among the top ten universities for IPR and Startup activities in 2022-2023. • Identified among top performing incubators under Startup India Seed fund scheme, Govt. of India since 2022. • Recognized as Nodal Institute under Assistance to StartUp Gujarat Cell of Industry Commissionerate, Govt. of Gujarat, (2021 onwards). • Registered Section 8 Company named "Krishna Edu Foundation" - KEF under company Act 2013 and provided end to end support to innovators and startups through Seed Funding, Co-Working Spaces, Mentoring, and Networking. • Selected as Implementing Agency (Group 2) under MeitY Startup Hub-GENESIS scheme in 2024. • 10000+ Students Outreached and Sensitized for innovation in 2020-2024. • 150+ innovations supported financially in 2020-2024. • 2200+ Startup Applications Received for incubation since 2022. • 36 Startups supported financially since 2021. • 55+ Startups incubated since 2021. • 75+ Mentors on board since 2020. • Revenue of ₹19.61 Crore Generated by Startups since 2022. • 150+ jobs created by Startups since 2022. • Startups appreciated at prestigious expos & events at G20 Finance Minister's and Central Bank Governors (FCBD) meeting, India Med Tech Expo, Startup Mahakumbh, Vibrant Gujarat Startup Conclave, Ministry of Ayush Pavillion at World Food India during 2023-2024. • Identified Centre for Entrepreneurship, Technology Incubation & Business Acceleration (CETIBA)-District Training Centre by SPIPA. • Entered into MOU (100+) with Government Agencies, Industries, and Industrial Associations. • Fostered active international collaborations with Carleton Global Academy-Carleton University, Canada, University of North Alabama (UNA), USA, Catholic University of Murcia (UCAM), Spain and North Southern Eastern University (NSU), Florida for academic exchange programs. • Provisions for the Freeships & scholarships for deserving, meritorious and economically weak students. • Library and Information Centre (built-up area of 20000 Sq. Ft.), accommodating 1000 students, consists of 59314 book resources, e-Resources, journals, periodicals of ₹2 Crores. • E-Library equipped with automated Library Management System (LMS) with RFID (Radio Frequency Identification System) Technology with SOUL2.0 (Software made by INFLIBNET) Centre and E-Journals form UGC Under DELNET available to foster multidisciplinary learning. • Computer centre is equipped with 165 Computers connected thorough dedicated leased Wi-Fi Internet. • Provisions for ICT enabled Smart Class rooms, internet and campus Wi-Fi, CCTV surveillance system, 100 mbps internet connectivity, Gymnasium, Transport facility, Auditorium, Sports ground, Student Community Learning Club, Shopping Complex, Banks & ATM, etc. available. • Existence of Student cells such as Anti-ragging Cell, Anti-Sexual harassment Cell, Anti-discrimination cell, Career and Placement Cell and Community Learning Club, etc. • Students demonstrated performance in examination and secured Gold Medals and results consistently remained in the range of 70 to 90% for UG programs and 90 to 100% for PG in PG programs. • Training, Career Counseling and Placements (TNP) cell recorded 80% students placement. • Students secured more than 40 Recognition Awards under leadership, distinguished services, outstanding achievements, NSS, blood donation, Thalassemia drive, best student award, sports, etc. • Both Boys and Girls hostel with all modern amenities, including AC facilities. Hygienic, modern mess available. • Recognized Krishna School of Science with Certificate of Excellence from MakeIntern (E-Cell of IIT Kharagpur) and Identified as Zonal Training Center in the region. • Implemented NEP - 2020 and KPGU registered on the ABC (Academic Bank of Credits) portal. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “The Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University seeks to be an Organization of Universal Eminence Serving the Cause of Higher Education, Health Care and Service to the Mankind, Ever in Pursuit of Newer Horizons, ingrained with Spirit of Continual Progress of Stakeholders.” Our Mission Globalization through creation, acquisition, preservation and exchange of knowledge. To provide collaborative environment for exchange of ideas, virtues & values. To nurture innovative and socially cultured global citizen. To develop good human being possessing scientific temper, compassion, empathy, courage and creative imagination. To foster multifaceted excellence in education and research outreach. Core Values The core values that underpin who we are to permeate the mission and assist in achieving its vision. The university respects the differences among individuals irrespective of socio-economic status, geographic location, religion, and cultural background so as to harbinger the perspective for the benefit of society. The core values translated into value statements represent the hallmark of KPGU as an institution of higher learning. KPGU has demonstrated to act out of these core values in the governance, management, operations, teaching and learning, research and innovation, engagement, and other activities of the university to achieve the vision and accompanying goals. • Academic Integrity KPGU upholds the principles of honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in every aspect. • Academic Excellence KPGU strives to achieve academic standards in teaching and research with a focus on the professional growth of students, to meet society, and industry needs. • Local & Global Commitment KPGU commits to adopt curricula and pedagogy for knowledge-enabling education to enhance employability and encourage an entrepreneurial spirit that acts as a catalyst for transformative change in research and education. • Inclusiveness & Mutual Respect KPGU embraces geographic diversity and works collaboratively that respect and value the contributions of each individual. • Dedication & Social Responsibilities KPGU resolves to work hard relentlessly to elevate academic activities and build an effective ecosystem with industry, alumni, and research laboratories to leverage benefits to students and society. • Sustainability KPGU adopts environmental sustainability in all practices and rejuvenates the curricula for Sustainable Development Goals-based education. Objectives The objectives of the university constitute the key determinants to integrate the vision with the mission mode for creating academic excellence. For this purpose, the objectives are to: • Provide quality education to students from a variety of educational and socio-economic backgrounds in applied science, engineering technology, health sciences, and management disciplines to meet national and globally competitive needs. • Strengthen the existing academic programs, start new tailor-made courses addressing the needs of the industries, and improve the academic and research environment of the University. • Encourage students to work on collaborative research projects and undertake postgraduate studies. • Evolve active bilateral instruments for industry involvement to propagate need-based research through learning and make a significant contribution to creating a knowledge base. • Set up innovation foundations to foster techno-entrepreneurship innovation among graduates. • Institute a strong community component in the curriculum to inculcate a social perspective. • Act as a trend-setting institution and develop as the premier technical institution in the state. • Disseminate knowledge by organizing talks, seminars, symposia, workshops, and conferences. • Restructure the systems for academic and administrative transparency and accountability through policies. • Do all such things as are necessary, or conducive to the attainment of all or any of the objectives uncovered in the above points. Our Leadership Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel Hon'ble Founder President, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara Hon'ble Founder President & Managing Trustee, Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT), Vadodara (Sponsoring Body of KPGU Vadodara) Hon'ble Founder & Director, Dr. Kiran C. Patel Medical College & Research Institute (KMCRI), Bharuch "Education is not meant merely to earn a degree; rather, it is an earnest pursuit of nurturing academic, co-academic, career, and global citizenship traits that foster the attainment of life goals." View Message from the Hon'ble President's Desk A great visionary philosopher and philanthropist driven by his aspirations for a Global Outlook, the Hon'ble Founder President, and Managing Trustee of Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT), Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel has been an ardent dynamic leader known for his passion for Excellence and relentless actions. Over the decades, he has transformed himself into a proactive administrator with the capacity to execute mega-projects associated with education, healthcare, and nursing sectors through his unique model consisting of Conception, Collaboration, Strategic Execution, completion of the projects & making them self-sustained, progressive institutions in tune with the advances of the world. In the past, the missed opportunities led him to an altruistic introspection about professional education, that motivated him to work for an equitable technical education. It’s here that, the mission of developing a Holistic Educational Campus to provide quality professional education was conceived to establish the BITS Edu Campus in 2003. Due to the abundant grace of Lord Shree Siddhivinayak and the relentless efforts of Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel, the institution successfully introduced academic programs at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Ayurveda, Nursing, and Sciences. This milestone not only expanded the academic horizons but also strengthened the status for upholding the principles of quality education, discipline amongst students, cultural ethos, and a commitment to a sustainable environment on the campus. With the patronage of Hon’ble founder President Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel and consistent academic growth, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara was established in 2021. The university introduced various programs like Diploma Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Food Technology (B. Tech), GNM (Nursing), B.B.A., B.Com, B.A., and Master's programs in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, and IT. Moreover, Ph.D. programs in Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, Science, and Physiotherapy were started for the benefit of students which placed KPGU at the forefront among the leading private universities in Gujarat. The institution offered numerous Freeships and Scholarships amounting to ₹ 16.20 Crores allocated to support meritorious underprivileged students since its inception. Besides, special initiatives such as the "Vidhava Kanya Kelavani Sahay" for the education of the girl child of widows, and the "Vidhava Kuldipak Kelavani Sahay" for the boy child of widows, practiced to support over four years. Moreover, four-year tuition fee waivers have been rendered to student aspirants admitted from Dhandhuka Taluka, as a tribute to his motherland. He has been actively contributing to the social cause of numerous organizations. He is the Founder and Promoter of Dr. Kiran C. Patel Medical College & Research Institute (KMCRI), Bharuch. He has been the Vice-President of Shri Sourashtra Leuva Patel Seva Samaj, Vadodara, Trustee of RMS Hospital, Dhandhuka, Founder Trustee of Kelavani Dham, Sardar Dham, Ahmedabad, Shree Siddhivinayak Temple, President of Shri Vighneshwari Charitable Trust: “Anandima No Vadalo”, Mansa, to name a few. He is the recipient of various Awards, including the Education Leadership Award, Global Education Excellence Award, Samaj Ratna Award, Indira Gandhi Shiksha Shiromani Award, Shiksha Bharti Award, and Samaj Gaurav Award. He was also appointed as a member of the Fee Regulatory Committee (Technical) by the Government of Gujarat for the period of 2020-to-2023 and extended for another term from April 2024 onwards. The inherent dynamic qualities, a mission mode approach adopted for Quality & Excellence, and vast experience out of completing several milestones in the past 20 years span assisted the SKECT in shaping Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara for the greater cause of higher professional education. The vision and mission articulated by Hon’ble Founder President, Shree Jagdishbhai D. Patel, to establish Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) Vadodara as the first foreign university campus in Gujarat now appears to be a reality due to the transformative framework of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and active cooperation rendered by Dr. Kiran C. Patel, a distinguished Indian American Philanthropist, who is closely associated with KPGU, Vadodara. The ingenious efforts of Dr. Kiran C. Patel made the top-ranked US-based university operational under his patronage is set to collaborate with KPGU, Vadodara, and establish Gujarat's first foreign university campus, adhering to international benchmarks and standards, ensuring a bright future for our students. Dr. Kiran C. Patel Hon'ble Vice President, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara Hon'ble Chairman, Dr. Kiran C. Patel Medical College & Research Institute (KMCRI), Bharuch Indian-American Philanthropist & Cardiologist, Tampa, Florida, USA "Follow your dreams, but understand that there is no shortcut in life. Passion and hard work, persistence, and remaining focused on what you want to achieve. Don't expect miracles, there is no microwave in life, you have to earn it the hard way." View Message from Dr. Kiran C. Patel Dr. Kiran C. Patel grew up ethnically to Asian-Indian Parents in Africa, was educated under the British Educational System, and then got his Diplomas from Cambridge University and The University of London. Then, he graduated in Medicine at Medical College in Gujarat, did his residency in Internal Medicine in New Jersey, and completed a Cardiology program affiliated with Columbia University of New York. Thereafter, Dr. Kiran Patel began his practice in cardiology for over four decades and soon became a distinguished Cardiologist in Tampa, Florida. This experience motivated him to develop a Physician Practice Management Company which provided 14 practices, including family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, and cardiology to serve more than 8000 patients which helped him to form a multi-specialty network. His success in Managed Care Contracts led to the foundation of Well Care HMO, Inc. to work with several hospitals in the USA. These efforts recognized Dr. Kiran Patel to serve as Chairman of Visionary Medical Systems and prompted to establishment of Drs. Kiran C. Patel and Pallavi Patel Family Foundation for the betterment of the world through health, education, and culture and respond in times of need. Over the period, Dr. Kiran C Patel has witnessed a paradigm shift in higher education & healthcare fostered by the ethos of service to humankind and observed its impact the world over, especially in the context of his motherland, India. In recognition of his efforts, the Govt. of India has felicitated him with Pravasi Bharatiya Samman. He has been making earnest endeavors to enhance the standards of higher education with high-quality, career-driven, globalized pedagogy in the centre of excellence. Towards this end, he has established centres of importance worldwide namely, Nova Southeastern University, University of South Florida, Centre for Global Solutions in the US, and Centre for Sustainable Development at IIT Gandhinagar. He has contributed over $ 800 million in charity for the said cause. India has remained at the centre of active collaboration in all endeavors. He established Dr. Kiran Patel Medical College & Research Center (KMCRI) at Bharuch in Gujarat. To further his aspirations for the people of India and Gujarat more objectively, he ideated the establishment of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) at Varnama, Vadodara under the sponsorship of Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT), to transform the science and technology domain to bring dynamics of societal change. In a tribute to his motherland and to provide global-level education to student aspirants from Gujarat, Dr. Kiran C. Patel is taking ingenious efforts to bring a prestigious top-ranked university from the USA, which is operational under his cooperation and inspiration to collaborate with KPGU, Vadodara, and establishing Gujarat's first foreign university campus as per the framework of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, adhering to international benchmarks and standards. This milestone marks a bright future for students and stands as a testament to Dr. Kiran C. Patel's unwavering commitment to education in his homeland and further expects that KPGU, Vadodara shall be the Gateway to Global Excellence in its true sense. Smt. Kamalben J. Patel Governing Body Member, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara Trustee, Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT), Vadodara (Sponsoring Body of KPGU Vadodara) "Every woman is strong, an embodiment of strength & sacrifice Empower her with equity she shall nurture the humankind" Smt. Kamalben J. Patel is an enthusiastic visionary leader dedicated to social upliftment and women's empowerment through education, skill development, and healthcare. As the Founder Trustee of the Shree Krishna Educational & Charitable Trust (SKECT) in Vadodara, Smt. Kamalben J. Patel has been instrumental in advancing the vision of higher education, health care, and service to the humanity. Her extensive involvement with various educational institutions, industrial units, and NGOs highlights her commitment to holistic student development. Notably, she is the promoter of the Dr. Kiran C. Patel Medical College and Research Institute (KMCRI) in Bharuch, Vadodara. Smt. Patel has also played a pivotal role in realizing the collective dream of establishing the Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara, which aims to be an institution of universal excellence, fostering the growth of all its stakeholders. R. K. Yadav Pro-Chancellor, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara "Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. - Nelson Mandela" Message from Pro-Chancellor Welcome to Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara - a transformative centre of learning where aspirations are empowered, talents are nurtured, and future leaders are created. At KPGU, we believe that education is not merely the pursuit of a degree; it is the journey of discovering one’s purpose, developing character, and creating the confidence to shape the future. Every student carries immense potential, and our mission is to provide an environment where knowledge meets innovation, values inspire leadership, and learning becomes a lifelong pursuit. In today’s dynamic and globally connected world, success belongs to those who continuously learn, adapt, innovate, and lead with integrity. Therefore, KPGU is committed to delivering academic excellence through advanced pedagogy, research-driven education, industry collaboration, entrepreneurship, digital transformation, and holistic personality development. We strive to prepare our students not only for successful careers, but also for meaningful lives filled with responsibility, compassion, and vision. At KPGU, students are at the heart of every initiative. We encourage them to think independently, dream fearlessly, embrace challenges confidently, and transform opportunities into achievements. Our objective is to create professionals who are intellectually competent, ethically grounded, socially responsible, and globally prepared. As Eleanor Roosevelt rightly said: "The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams." We strongly believe in the synthesis of Knowledge, Innovation, Values, and Humanity, which forms the foundation of our educational philosophy and institutional growth. Through this vision, KPGU continuously advances towards excellence, empowering students to become innovators, creators, researchers, entrepreneurs, and nation-builders. Let us learn together, innovate together, and create a brighter future together.
